title: Files panel: browse the focused terminal's folder, preview text files, and open or copy any file
summary: A Files panel in the left icon strip browses the focused terminal's worktree or project folder one level at a time, dims git-ignored entries, previews text files read-only and opens or copies any file; its backend refuses paths and links leading out of the folder and never lets git run a repository's configured commands.
friction: Three review rounds, each finding a new way the file-browsing commands escaped their folder or ran a command (a junction leading out, git core.fsmonitor, a partial clone's lazy fetch through core.sshCommand); the last fix merged on a green local gate under the confirming-review exception
lessons_learned: A Tauri command that reads the user's files or runs git inside a folder the person browses needs adversarial probes before the first review: links leading out (canonical path against canonical root), and git calls with --no-index, -c core.fsmonitor=false and GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 so a repository's config can never run a command
